n: const APP_VERSION="v17";(()=>{const fix=()=>{const root=document.querySelector("#app")||document.body;const hs=[...root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4")].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null);const sales=hs.some(e=>/laporan penjualan/i.test(e.textContent||""));const pnl=hs.some(e=>/laporan laba rugi/i.test(e.textContent||""));if(!sales||pnl)return;root.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(e=>{if(e.children.length>2)return;const t=(e.textContent||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");if(!/^(total\s+)?omset(?:\s|:|$)/i.test(t)&&!/^pendapatan per produk$/i.test(t))return;let p=e;for(let i=0;i<5&&p.parentElement;i++,p=p.parentElement){if(p.classList&&(p.classList.contains("card")||p.classList.contains("item")||p.classList.contains("row")))break;}if(p&&p!==root)p.style.display="none";});};new MutationObserver(fix).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});fix();})();
